assessments.reasoning: SAP Release 754 identifies this as a full access rule in CDS DCL. Its opening Effect paragraph says the GRANT SELECT ON form without WHERE gives access to the referenced CDS entity without conditions, with entity applicability inherited from the conditional rule description.

challenge.method: Compare the grant-rule syntax and its optional REDEFINITION, the conditional-rule WHERE form, and the notes on ABAP SQL privilege and rule-composition effects.
challenge.results: WHERE marks the separate conditional-rule form. The full-access syntax explicitly permits an optional REDEFINITION, while the stated DCL access condition remains unconditional. The notes distinguish other pathways to the same DCL effect.

limitations: The referenced CDS entity must be eligible for access rules. The claim covers the DCL effect and gives no general application-level authorization or ABAP SQL bypass guarantee.
